notes.title: Small bugfix 0.0.3
notes.notes:
- Game features now a fixed screen aspect ratio (16:9).
- Win screen main menu button works properly now.
- Win screen time survived gets displayed correctly now.
- Having more than 3 weapons doesn't crash the upgrade menu anymore.
- Sniper and shield upgrade have correct english now.

notes.title: Restart button patch
notes.notes:
This patch includes:
 - Restart button on game over screen
 - Select screen button on game over screen
 - Pilots will be saved across runs and game sessions
 - Planes will be saved across runs and game sessions
 - Weapons will be saved across runs and game sessions
 - Your choice of map will be saved across runs and game sessions
